body_markdown:
As Shows continues to expand, the desk welcomes new editors and production staff.


As Shows continues to expand, the desk welcomes new editors and production staff. Rebecca Blandón, Eddie Costas, Pat Gunther and Paula Neudorf step into new roles within Shows, and RJ Sachdev joins as a video editor.


*REBECCA BLANDON* *Credit: Alex Nuñez*


Rebecca Blandón joins the Shows Department as a full-time video producer / assistant video editor. Rebecca has been supporting the team in a temporary assignment since 2025 when she joined as an assistant video editor. She will continue to work with the Shows department and the Video Operations team by ingesting and organizing media, managing quality control and creating social videos. Her steady presence, technical know-how and attention to detail are central to the department’s ability to deliver high-quality video on tight timelines.


Rebecca has previously worked as a multimedia journalist at The Boston Globe, reporting on local features and news stories, and as a producer and editor for PBS, Frontline and AXIOS.


*REBECCA BLANDON* *Credit: Alex Nuñez*


*EDDIE COSTAS*


Eddie Costas has moved into a new role on the Shows team as the team’s first post-production supervisor. Eddie joined The Times in 2024 as a senior video editor in our early podcast video operations. He worked closely with “The Interview” as the show grew beyond destination listening and into destination viewing for conversations with the world’s most fascinating people. Eddie has also worked on “Popcast,” “Hard Fork,” “Modern Love,” “The Daily” and “Cannonball.” In his new role, Eddie will work closely with the Video Operations and Engineering teams to build stronger and more efficient post-production workflows. He will also manage our team of video editors.
Before joining The Times, Eddie worked as a producer and editor for broadcast and digital media at Univision, Gizmodo Media Group, Genius and The Verge.


*EDDIE COSTAS*


*PAT GUNTHER* *Credit: Amanda Webster (NYT)*


Pat Gunther joins the Shows department as a full-time video editor. Since joining the team on a temporary assignment in 2025, Pat has contributed to many episodes of “The Interview,” “Cannonball” and “Popcast,” where he often also supports the team as a camera operator. Pat will continue his work across the Shows portfolio as one of our most trusted hands in identifying and crafting short-form videos for our own platforms, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.


Prior to joining The Times, Pat worked as a video producer and editor at ESPN and The Volume.


*PAT GUNTHER* *Credit: Amanda Webster (NYT)*


*PAULA NEUDORF*


Paula Neudorf is joining The New York Times as a full-time senior video journalist on “The Interview.”Paula has been central to creating a visual identity and leading video production for the show over the past year while working on temporary assignment, including producing interviews with Tucker Carlson and Gisèle Pelicot. Now, she will continue to strengthen video workflows as well as editorially produce episodes.


Paula is an Emmy Award-winning journalist, director and producer. Prior to joining The Times, she worked at Al Jazeera, NBC News and Vice News.


*PAULA NEUDORF*


*RJ SACHDEV*


RJ Sachdev has joined Shows as a video editor across our portfolio. RJ will work alongside “The Interview,” “Hard Fork,” “Popcast” and our development teams to edit and produce vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. RJ brings years of experience working in short-form media and a keen eye for creating videos that feel just as native to The Times as they do social media.


Before joining The Times, RJ spent six years working on the cold opens at “The Late Show with Stephen Colbert,” collaborating with producers, writers, editors and teams across the show. Previously, he worked on the production team for “Always Late with Katie Nolan” at ESPN.


Please join me in congratulating Rebecca, Eddie, Pat, Paula and RJ!


*RJ SACHDEV*
